result.description: AI-powered web scraping platform: give a URL and prompt, get JSON/CSV; also HTML/Markdown scrape, screenshots, web search, and managed scrapers via REST API.
result.auth_detail: API token created in dashboard (API Tokens > New Token), sent in `x-api-token` header; marketplace endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. OAuth 2.1 only for the hosted MCP server, not the REST API.
result.access_detail: Free plan with no credit card (docs say 100 tokens/month; plan table says 1,000 — inconsistent). Pro (200k tokens, residential proxies) and Enterprise are paid. Token creation is self-serve in dashboard.
result.api_notes: REST/JSON. Platform API at api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1 and scraper API at api.mrscraper.com. Covers scrape HTML/Markdown/JSON, screenshot, brand, web search, listing page, sitemap; AI and manual scraper create/rerun/bulk rerun/self-heal; workflow; results; analytics; account/subscription. Individual endpoint pages not read; list from llms.txt. SDKs for Python, Node, LangChain, plus CLI.

evidence.quote: Include your API token in the `x-api-token` HTTP header on every request.
authenticate using the standard RFC 6750 `Authorization` header with a Bearer token.
The Free plan includes **100 tokens per month** with no credit card required.
Use this exact URL, including the `/mcp` path.
API keys remain supported for clients without OAuth.
just a URL and a prompt
